extras.html:
Frequently Asked Questions-

  • Fleet policy portion- any and all accidents/incidents/citations whether on or off duty must be reported toSS within 72 hours. What should I do if I am in an accident with an individual in the vehicle with me? Call your program specialist or the On call Program Specialist.
  • PTO- it is the responsibility of the employee to ensure that they have worked a minimum of 40 hours each week or have the PTO hours available to cover any deficiencies of 40 hours. If hours have not been worked and PTO time is not available to cover the deficiency, then disciplinary action will occur. All hours must be entered by Monday at noon at the end of the pay period or will be paid on the following check.
  • Call offs - must be done via phone call only; texting/emailing are not acceptable. The phone call must be made to the supervising Program Specialist or the on-call Program Specialist. If you are ill, the covid line must also be called. 888-556-7930. The covid line does not accept text messages.
  • PTO requests should be submitted to the Program Specialist 2 weeks prior.
  • Residential Organization- due to being a residential company, the individual that you are assigned to support, and the weekly schedule, may change upon the discretion and needs of the agency.
  • CP/SE/SH- services that are a 1:1 service where the support staff must be with the individual at all times to ensure the service requirement is met.
  • Personal errands may never be completed on company time or while providing billable services
  • Completion of paperwork/duties- is expected to be completed in totality prior to leaving shift.
  • Attendance Records, iCM clock in and clock out and mileage punches should be completed in real-time.
  • Our supported individuals, although some may be more capable than others, may require assistance with personal hygiene and keeping their home clean and in compliance with regulations. It is the expectation that support staff ensure that the home is kept clean and in compliance if the supported individual refuses to assist with cleaning. It is the expectation that support staff will assist an individual in maintaining proper hygiene as needed.
  • Med admin - 5 rights are expected to be completed with each med pass.
  • An individual's personal funds should never be taken home. If an individual is saving for an activity/event those funds may be set aside and placed in a locked box at the home or given to the Program Specialist to hold on to.
  • If Caretracker is not working, use the web browser instead of the app. If still not working notify on-call. Document your time on paper as you normally would, then enter your punches and transportation logs into iCM once the system is back up and you have service. This is also the only time transportation logs should be added after the fact rather than in real time.
  • Who do I reach out to if I need additional support for the individual I'm working with? Reach out to your PS and they will either provide additional support or our DSP Mentor or BS will assist.
  • What to do if a door alarm/window alarm is not working? If an alarm is not working, On-call or PS should be notified immediately so a replacement can be installed.
  • Do I have Shared Support's On call number programmed in my phone? 570-213-9762.
  • If your individual is not feeling well or has a fall, what do you do? Call your program specialist, or On-call if after office hours or on weekends.
  • Document any incidents that could lead to a bruise or mark on the body and report any bruises with an unidentifiable source or skin concerns immediately.
  • Approved OTC medications such as Tylenol etc., do not need on call approval prior to administration.
  • Any PRN for agitation needs approval from On-call prior to administration.
  • Do you have all necessary items for the individual when you are preparing to go out into the community (Medications, prn medication, sensory items, incontinent products).
